description: This file defines the UsersController class, which handles user-related HTTP requests such as creating a new user and user login in an ASP.NET Core application. It uses MediatR to send commands for processing.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller for managing user-related HTTP endpoints such as registration and login, utilizing dependency injection of IMediator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user by sending a Create.Command via the mediator.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user login by sending a Login.Command via the mediator.
